name: ToggleGroup
whenToUse: Switching a view or a filter among 2–5 options, all visible: Grid / List, All / Unread, Monthly / Yearly.

whenNotToUse.text: A choice in a form that’s saved later

anatomy.description: `type` single/multiple, `appearance` (`outlined` for a visible segmented control, `ghost` for toolbars).
sized to their content, not stretched to equal widths.

do.caption: Same thing shown differently — a view switch.
do.example:
<ToggleGroup type="single" appearance="outlined" defaultValue="grid" aria-label="Layout">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="grid" aria-label="Grid"><ViewGrid /></ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="list" aria-label="List"><List /></ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>

dont.caption: Different sections of content are Tabs, not a toggle.
dont.example:
<ToggleGroup type="single" appearance="outlined" defaultValue="general" aria-label="Settings">
  <ToggleGroupItem value="general">General</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="billing">Billing</ToggleGroupItem>
  <ToggleGroupItem value="security">Security</ToggleGroupItem>
</ToggleGroup>

a11y: Give the group an `aria-label`. Arrow keys move between items.
Single: one is always on — don’t let it be unselected unless “none” is a real option.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Square, icon-only item. Detected automatically when the only child is an icon; pass it to override.
